fullDescription: Editorial, print-inspired button library: nine CSS-only serif underline animations plus framed fill/ghost buttons, on cream paper with ink + burgundy.

structured.summary: A typographic, print-inspired button library landing page where every control reads like editorial type. CSS-only underline and link-button animations set in a serif display face, on a warm cream paper ground with ink-black text and a single note of burgundy. Layout is a hairline-ruled editorial grid: sticky nav, asymmetric hero, a 3-column showcase of nine underline studies (each shown active and at rest), a framed-buttons + states section, an inline-in-prose demo, and a dark colophon footer.

style.description: Editorial / print-magazine aesthetic: warm cream paper, ink-black ink, one accent of burgundy. Display serif (Fraunces) for headlines and the interactive labels; clean grotesque sans (Inter) for body and meta. Everything is divided by 1px hairline rules at 14% opacity, like a typographic specimen sheet. No shadows, no gradients, square corners by default; restraint and whitespace carry the design.
style.prompt: Design in an editorial print-specimen style. Palette: background cream #faf6ef, primary text/ink #1c1815, single accent burgundy #7b2d3b; selection highlight is burgundy bg with cream text. Dividers are hairlines: border color rgba(28,24,21,0.14). Fonts: Fraunces (serif display, weights 300-700 plus italics, optical sizing) for headlines and interactive serif labels; Inter (weights 400/500/600) for body, meta labels, and small caps. Body text uses ink at reduced opacity (ink/65, ink/85). Meta labels are uppercase with wide letter-spacing (0.06em-0.22em) at 12-12.5px, weight 600. Numerals use tabular-nums (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) with 0.02em tracking. No box-shadows, no gradients, square corners default (one optional pill outline). Antialiased. Generous vertical rhythm, lots of cream whitespace.

layout_and_structure.description: A centered editorial column maxing at ~1180px with 24-32px side padding. Top to bottom: sticky translucent nav, asymmetric 12-col hero (8/4 split), a full-bleed 3-column hairline-ruled showcase grid of nine studies, a framed-buttons section with a 3-column states matrix and an inline-in-prose paragraph demo, then a dark colophon footer. All major sections separated by horizontal hairline rules; the grid cells separated by vertical+horizontal hairlines.

prompts.prompt: Sticky top header, z-50, background cream at 85% opacity with backdrop-blur, bottom hairline border, 64px tall. Inside a max-w-[1180px] row with px-6/px-8: left is wordmark 'Underline' + italic burgundy 'Studies' in Fraunces ~17-19px weight 500, tight tracking. Right is a nav of small (13.5px, weight 500) links: 'Showcase', 'Primary', 'Colophon', each an animated left-to-right underline link; plus a burgundy weight-600 'Get the set' with a ph:arrow-up-right icon. Hide the first two links below sm breakpoint.

Section with bottom hairline. Inside max-w-[1180px], padding-top clamp 64-96px, a 12-col grid (gap-y-8, gap-x-10, items-end). Left col-span-8: a burgundy uppercase eyebrow 'A TYPOGRAPHIC BUTTON LIBRARY' (12px, tracking 0.22em, weight 600); a giant Fraunces serif headline weight 400, leading 0.95, tracking -0.02em, clamp(2.6rem,7.2vw,5.6rem): 'Buttons that read / like *editorial* type.' with 'editorial' in italic weight 500; then a 34rem-max paragraph in ink/65 at ~16px describing a CSS-only underline and link-button collection. Right col-span-4, bottom-aligned: a small uppercase label 'MORE IN THIS COLLECTION', two serif 19px swap-through underline links ('Underline styles', 'Framed buttons') stacked, then a burgundy-fill framed button 'Browse the set' (square, border, fills burgundy on hover) next to a 40x40 square ghost icon button (ph:github-logo).

Section id=showcase. A header row (max-w-[1180px], py-7, bottom hairline) with a Fraunces 22-26px weight-500 title 'Underline studies' on the left and a right-aligned uppercase tabular-num meta 'NINE STUDIES · SHOWN ACTIVE & AT REST'. Below: a responsive grid 1/2/3 columns with hairline left border (lg) and per-cell hairline right+bottom borders so it reads as a ruled specimen sheet. Each cell is min-h-[210px], px-6/8, py-12/14, flex-col justify-between: a small tabular numeral (01-09) at top in ink/55 weight 600; at the bottom a large Fraunces 26-28px weight-500 link demonstrating one underline animation, with a 12.5px uppercase caption beneath naming the technique. The nine: 01 Center-out rule ('About us'), 02 Left-to-right reveal ('Shop the look', shown active), 03 Swap-through ('Track package', active), 04 Double hairline ('Read the essay'), 05 Rise from baseline ('Highlight', active, burgundy), 06 Center bracket ('Contents', active), 07 Dotted to solid ('Footnotes'), 08 Strike to underline ('Sold out', active), 09 Slide & rule ('Subscribe'). Several are frozen in their active state via an is-on class so the static page demonstrates the effect.

Section id=primary, top hairline. Header row like the showcase: Fraunces title 'Framed buttons' + uppercase meta 'DEFAULT · HOVER · DISABLED'. Body in max-w-[1180px], py-14/20: a 3-column grid (gap-12 / lg gap-10). Col 1 'PRIMARY · INK FILL': a bordered button 'Start designing' with ph:arrow-right that translates on hover (fill rises from bottom in ink), a solid ink/cream 'Hovered state' with ph:check, and a disabled outline button at reduced opacity. Col 2 'ACCENT · BURGUNDY': bordered burgundy 'Upgrade plan' (burgundy fill on hover), solid burgundy/cream 'Hovered state' with ph:sparkle, and a rounded-full 'Pill, outlined' burgundy. Col 3 'QUIET · GHOST & TEXT': an outline 'Outline button' (inverts to ink on hover), a serif 18px ltr-underline text link 'Learn the syntax' with ph:arrow-up-right, and a burgundy serif double-underline link 'View on the canvas'. Buttons are square by default (one pill exception), border 1px, px-7 py-3.5, 14px weight-600 tracking-wide.

Below the grid, mt-16/20, top hairline, a 12-col grid: left col-span-3 small uppercase label 'IN THE FLOW OF TEXT'; right col-span-9 a 20-23px Fraunces serif paragraph (leading 1.7, ink/85, max-w-44rem) with three inline animated links embedded mid-sentence: a center-out 'link to a brief', a burgundy rise 'highlight a passage', and a swap-through burgundy 'the appendix', proving the controls live inside running prose without breaking the line.

Section id=colophon with dark inversion: background ink #1c1815, text cream. max-w-[1180px], py-16/20. A 12-col grid items-end: left col-span-7 an uppercase cream/60 'COLOPHON' label and a Fraunces weight-400 headline clamp(2rem,4.6vw,3.4rem) 'Copy a study, paste it / into your *prose*.' (prose italic, cream). Right col-span-5: a 15px cream/65 paragraph ('Pure CSS, no JavaScript, no dependencies. Set in Fraunces and Inter, rendered in ink, cream, and a single note of burgundy.') then a solid cream/ink 'Copy the set' button with ph:copy that hovers to burgundy, plus a quiet 'Source on GitHub' text link with ph:github-logo. Bottom strip: mt-14, top border cream/15, a row with a Fraunces italic 'UnderlineStudies' and a tabular-num 'No. 01-09 · CSS-only · 2026'.

special_ui_components.prompt: All pure CSS, no JS, driven by ::before/::after pseudo-elements and transforms. (01) Center-out rule: 1.5px underline scaleX(0)->1 from center, 0.45s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1). (02) Left-to-right reveal: same but transform-origin left, 0.4s. (03) Swap-through: two rules, one scales out to the right while a second scales in from the left with a 0.12s delay (overflow hidden). (04) Double hairline: two 1px rules at bottom -3px and -7px, second delayed 0.07s, both scaleX left. (05) Rise from baseline: a burgundy 18%-opacity block grows from height 0 to 42% behind the text (z-index -1) and text turns burgundy. (06) Center bracket: two 1.5px segments grow from the center outward to 50% width each. (07) Dotted to solid: background-image linear-gradient sized 4px x 1px repeating, transitions background-size to 100% x 1.5px. (08) Strike to underline: a strikethrough rule scales out from the right while an underline scales in from the left (0.1s delay). (09) Slide & rule: inner text translateY(-2px), a burgundy underline scales in from left, text turns burgundy. Provide a matching .is-on class on each that freezes the hover end-state so a static screenshot demonstrates the effect.

Bordered square button, position relative, overflow hidden, isolation isolate. A ::before pseudo (absolute inset-0) starts translateY(101%) and slides to translateY(0) on hover over 0.42s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1), revealing a solid fill (ink #1c1815 by default, burgundy #7b2d3b via btn-fill-burgundy) while the text color transitions to cream #faf6ef. z-index -1 keeps fill behind the label.
1px ink border, transparent background; on hover background fills ink #1c1815, text cream, border ink, transition 0.35s. Square corners.
Inline ph:arrow-right icon (.arrow-i) that translateX(5px) on hover over 0.35s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), pairs with the fill animation.

structured.special_notes: Pure CSS, zero JavaScript, no dependencies beyond fonts (Fraunces + Inter from Google Fonts) and Iconify Phosphor icons (ph:*). Hairline rules at rgba(28,24,21,0.14) are the core structural device. Each study ships with an .is-on twin of its :hover rule so a static render visibly shows the animation end-state. Accessibility: disabled control uses reduced-opacity border/text + cursor-not-allowed + select-none. Responsive: nav links collapse below sm; hero and footer 12-col grids stack to single column; showcase grid steps 3->2->1 columns and drops the lg-only vertical borders.
